title: Law to require online map of snow plowing data
summary: This bill would require the Department of Sanitation, working with the Departments of Transportation and Information Technology and Telecommunications, to equip snow plows with GPS and publish a public website tracking current and historical snow plowing operations. The website must show a map updated every 15 minutes during storms, let users filter by date, storm, borough and district, and include overlays for schools, hospitals and other critical facilities. The map and historical GPS data must be made available by October 31, 2027.
